headline: JFK in 1962: why he wanted an *across-the-board tax cut*
quote: Every dollar released from taxation will help create a new job
title: JFK explains his tax cut plan (1962 footage)
caption: August 13, 1962: President Kennedy makes the case for cutting income taxes across the board.
context: Passed in 1964, after his death: the top tax rate fell from *91% to 70%*.
